test_float_numeric_index_constructor: test constructing a pandas Index with float32 or float64 dtype from lists and numpy arrays
test_float_numeric_index_repr_roundtrip: test repr roundtrip of a pandas FloatNumericIndex with mixed and float data across float32 and float64 dtypes
test_float_numeric_index_nan_handling: test NaN handling and fillna behavior of a pandas FloatNumericIndex with float64 dtype
test_float_numeric_index_lookups: test datetime-like value lookups using .loc, .at, and .iloc on a Series with a float numeric index
test_int_numeric_index_constructor: test constructing a pandas Index with int64, int32, int16, or int8 dtype from lists, arrays, and iterables
test_int_numeric_index_is_monotonic: test is_monotonic_increasing and _is_strictly_monotonic_increasing properties of a pandas IntNumericIndex
test_float16_index_not_supported: test that constructing a pandas Index with float16 dtype raises NotImplementedError
test_uint_index_does_not_convert: test that uint64 Series index values are not converted to float64 when using .loc with list or object array
test_map_dtype_inference: test dtype inference when mapping an Index with operations that overflow or convert unsigned to signed
